speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Maculopapular drug eruption (Amoxicillin-induced). The history of rash appearing after starting amoxicillin, spreading from flexural areas to the trunk, combined with low-grade fever and joint pain in a previously healthy child, is classic for this reaction. The CBC results will likely show mild leukocytosis but are not expected to show signs of severe infection or anaphylaxis. No further testing is required; I will recommend stopping the medication immediately and providing antihistamines for symptom relief.
